_notes: Extra training templates (HANDOFF decision 23). Appended after the held-out templates, so held-out indices and text are unchanged; extra template j of a direction gets index len(templates) + j.
Written for syntactic variety the original 25 lack: fronted adverbials, subordinate clauses, appositives, passives, colon frames.

Leakage rule, fixed before any run with these: no template paraphrases a held-out template. Excluded on purpose: 'When ...' clauses, 'speak of', 'mean', 'biography', 'remembered as', 'turns out', 'disputes', 'In every account', 'find ... in', 'currently lives'.
Same answer conventions as templates.json. s_forward must not end in a bare '{name} ... is'.
